title: Non-Object-Safe Default Trait Additions (Half-Completed Trait Upgrades)
pattern: Adding a generic method with a default implementation to an existing trait to avoid breaking downstream implementations, but inadvertently making the trait non-object-safe (`dyn Trait`) in the process.
why_bad: Compile-time breakage. Adding a non-object-safe method immediately blocks downstream callers from utilizing trait objects, disrupting polymorphic collections and dynamic dispatch patterns across the entire codebase.
detection:
The linter must observe:
1. A trait that was previously used as a trait object (`dyn Trait`).
2. A new method added to the trait containing generic type parameters or requiring `Self: Sized`, which compromises its object safety.
